title: Oxva Origin SE Replacement Pod 2ml - 2 Pack
description: Sleek, light to carry and supremely versatile, the Oxva Origin SE pod mod kit offers an unbeatable combination of style, performance and convenience. These replacement OXVA Origin SE Pods are available in a 2ml e-liquid capacity, and you can easily keep an eye on the level of your e-liquid thanks to the pod’s smooth, transparent all-in-one design. Topping up is simple, with easy leak-free refilling via the side-fill port. The comfortable drip tip can be replaced with any other 510 compatible drip tip should you choose to. The pod is held in place with strong magnets, and when removed reveals the fill port, which is protected by a leak-resistant tag on the side of the pod. The OXVA Origin SE Pod is compatible with Oxva’s exceptional Unione series coils, which offer increased longevity and outstanding flavour in a variety of resistances – from MTL to DL sub-ohm.
